description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Patron of the Arts, adding {C}{C}.
Patron of the Arts dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
